don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ sogs kyis don gcig sa de yin/ so skye'i sa ji srid lta ba de dang rjes su mthun pa tsam yang ma rnyed/ nam rnyed pa nas byang 'phags su song*/ yin lugs mngon sum pa ni byang 'phags dag gis kyang ma gzigs pas/ de dag gi mnyam bzhag rnam grangs pa'i don dam du 'jog pa yin no// yang so skye'i dus na ni gzhan stong gi 'char tshul gtso che/ de'i rgyu mtshan kun rdzob bsal bya dang*/ don dam bral bar mthong bas gzung 'dzin ma spangs pa'i phyir ro// de'i tshe'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid gzhan stong gi khungs su mi 'gro ste/ so skye'i dus kyi rnam kun mchog ldan ni/ gsang ba 'dus par/ rim pa gsum pa la kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes gsungs pa de yin la/ de ni snang ba'i steng du snang ba gang yin pa der rung ba zhig mi rnyed pa kho na ste/ sgyu ma mkhan po la rang nyid kyis sprul ba'i rta glang snang ba lta bu'o// des rang bzhin med pa'am mi bden pas snang ba de la dag pa'i sgyu mar bzhag pa yin no// de ltar yang dbang mdor bstan las/ rang bzhin nyid phyir skye mi 'gyur// sna tshogs 'di ni rang bzhin med// dngos po dngos med mtshan nyid gcig /ces pa'i 'grel par dpal nā ro pa chen pos/ kun rdzob tu don bya ba byed pa'i dngos po'i ngo bo ste/ de kho na rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid kyi phyir dngos po med pa'i mtshan nyid do zhes gsungs pas so// 'di la dgongs nas rgyal dbang rjes/ snang ba'i steng du stong pa'i rang zhal mthong ba la rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid zer/ gsungs so// de lta bu'i stong nyid so so'i skye bo la 'char ba'i tshe las snang rags pa 'di dang bral bas stong nyid 'khor ba sbyang ba dang*/ stong pa de yang snang ba'i steng du khyer na rtsal che ba'i phyir thabs la slob ste/ thabs shes de gnyis gzhi gcig dus gcig tu mi phyed pas mnyam par gyur pa 'di/

skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i thabs de yin/ gnas 'di la dgongs nas 'khrul pa che bdo ba na ye shes che bdo// gti mug che bdo ba na rig pa rtsal che sogs bka' brgyud rin po ches gsung 'dis spang blang med/ srid zhi mnyam nyid de yang so so skye bo la lam 'jug khyer 'di bstan pas sngags kyi dngos zin zab par song*/ lam khyer 'di yod na rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa la 'jug 'di ma byung ring stong nyid de bsam par btang nas bskyed rim gtso bor slob pas bskyed rim lus su song*/ lus bsam de'i dbye bas lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad kyang zung 'jug tu 'gro ste/ lus la bsam pa rab zhugs nam mkha' bzhin du ro mnyam pa dang bsam pa'i dbus su lus nyid kyang*// rang bzhin yon tan dbang las kha dog rnams kyi dbye ba rnal 'byor ldan pas shes par bya ba ste// ser po nag po dmar po dkar po kha dog rnams ni sa dang rlung dang me dang chu rnams so// ye shes nam mkha' dag kyang lus dang bsam pa'i rab tu dbye bas ljang khu dang ni sngon por 'gyur// zhes so/ de bas bskyed rim gyi sngon tu stong pa nyid bsam pa bsam pa/ mdangs 'gag med du 'char ba lhar slong ba de lus/ dang po zab pa dang*/ gnyis pa la gsal bar byas nas/ stong gsal lam zab gsal de gnyis dbyer med du 'gro ba la lhar snang dus lha'i rags 'dzin med pa zhig dgos pas/ brtag gnyis su/ dang po la chos nyid/ de nas lha/ de nas rang rig gi dag pa gsungs pa'o// 'o na rnal 'byor re re'i mthar nga rgyal 'dzin pa gsungs pa de dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro snyam na mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni lha'i snang ba brtan por bsgrub pa'i phyir te gya nom pa'i lhar lta ba ni ma yin no// gya nom pa'i lhar lta na de ni sman ma zhu ba lta bu/

thag pa'i sgrog 'grol pa la gser gyi sgrog dam pos bcings pa lta bur song ste sngar las duḥkha/ de bas snga ma'i lam khyer med pas bskyed kyang des srid pa mi ldog ba rgya 'dre lba ba dgu brtsegs 'jigs byed kyi rnam par byas nas 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas shes so// de bas na bsam gtan pa zad par sa sogs sgom pa lta bu byung man/ sngags la sogs pa'i dngos grub thob kyin rtog pa tsam po 'dis brtags pa der snang ngo snyam pa ni rtog pa'i gsal snang nyid de/ bud med bzang mo dang dus btab pa'i skyes bu la bud med de'i gzugs 'char ba bzhin yin pas don mi 'grub/ 'o na 'di rtog sgom zhes gsungs na ji ltar rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur zhe na/ bskyed rim dang phyag rgya dang po rtog par bsdu ba ni 'khor ba mtha' dag rtog par bzhag pa'i skabs kyis te/ de thams cad rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa kun tu rtog pa yang dag par rtog pa dang so sor rtog pa zhes dbye ba'i phyi ma'i bye brag tu 'gyur ro// snga ma ni rtog ge pas bzhag pa bzhin sgra don 'drer rung ba'i shes pa kho na'o// stong phyogs rgyu byas/ snang phyogs lha'i 'khor lo 'bras bur byas pa'i zab gsal 'di tsam bya ba'i rgyud la yang dgos na de rnal 'byor bla med kyi nyams len mthar thug go snyam pa tsho der zad do// bya rgyud du de mi dgos na/ de'i lha drug sgom pa'i byang chub sems sam stong nyid kyi lha sngon du btang nas phyag rgya dang gzugs brnyan gyi lha phyis bsgom pa don med pa dang*/ 'di'i thabs ni 'di nyid kyi lha drug la sogs pa yin la/ shes rab ni stong nyid dbu ma pas rnam par gzhag pa de kho na yin no// 'dis thabs shes dbyer med lam du mi byed na rgyu'i theg chen las 'di dman par yang 'gyur ro// de'i phyir theg pa 'di yang rim gnyis dang ldan pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa de la kun rdzob kyi bden pa rnam pa dang bcas pa dang*/

de nas don dam pa'i bden pa rnam pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas dgos par bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum kar/ dbang bzhi dang ni rim gnyis med// dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis// rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin// zhes pa'ang tshig la rton pa kho nar song bas byis pa'o// ji ltar tshig la rton par song na// don de gnyis dang bskyed rdzogs gcig yin pa ma shes par bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim zhes pa'i tha snyad ma byung bas so snyam pa'i phyir ro// des na byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba skor dag tu don gcig la ming mang po yod pa las gang rung gcig gis bshad kyang de bshad par bsgrubs pa dang 'gal ba yin no// yang*/ dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan na// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min// zhes rang tshig 'dis kyang gnod pas lugs de tshar gcad kyi gnas so// legs par grub pa yan chad du// rang gis dbang bskur ma thob na// sems skyed thob kyang gsang sngags bkag /zer ba dang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs par// 'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas ni// 'phrin las 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir// cho ga shes na sgrub par snang*// zer ba'ang 'gal ste dam tshig gsum bkod bya spyod thun mong par 'dren pa'i phyir/ legs par grub pa dang mchog dman 'byed na/ 'di gong mar byed rigs pas so// de ltar rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dri ma med pa'i 'od 'dir/ gzugs brnyan la sogs rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo bsgom pa goms par byas pa yis// grub pa 'jig rten pa dag 'grub 'gyur gyi// 'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po ga la zhig /ces snang phyogs bskyed rim smad pa lta bus gsungs/ rang bzhin ye shes su ma shes pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rdo rje gur las/ gal te stong pa thabs yin na// de tshe sangs rgyas nyid ma 'gyur// 'bras bu rgyu las gzhan med phyir// thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin// lta ba rnams las log rnams dang*// bdag tu lta ba 'tshol rnams kyis// bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir// stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan// de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes// thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste// sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid ni myur bar 'gyur// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// de phyir thabs des bsgrub bya ste// thabs ni ston pa'i gzugs can no// zhes pas stong phyogs smad pa lta bur gsungs/

phyi ma 'di rim 'jug gi dbang du mdzad pa ste/ 'bum lngar/ rnam rtog rgya ru tshud pa yi// 'gro ba gsum po rnams gzigs nas// ji lta ji ltar grol 'gyur ba// de dang de yi thabs bstan to// rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcings la// thog mar rtog pa'i cho ga bstan// rnam rtog rang bzhin shes pa na// mi rtogs pa la rnam 'jug bya// zhes dang*/ dpe'i sgo nas kyang der/ dang por re zhig zhing sbyang phyir// drug cu pa yi 'bru rnams btab// phyi nas dag pa'i zhing rnams la// sā lu'i 'bras ni btab pa'o// zhes so// 'di yang*/ chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis// rtog pa'i gnyen por rtog pa thong*// bzlog sgom rtog pa'i skor 'ded yin// zhes gsungs pa'i gnad de brtag gnyis las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom// spros pa rmi lam ltar byas na// spros pa nyid ni spros med byed// de yang tha mal gyi rnam rtog gi rgyun 'di tshugs mi thub kyang 'grogs yun ring bas bzlog dka' bar byung*/ bskyed rim de ltar ma yin pa gsar byung yin pas snga ma de 'bral ba la glo bur ba'i rnam rtog bsgom pa ste/ gur las tha mal rnam rtog gzhom don du// bsgom pa yang dag rab tu bsgrags// zhes gsungs/ gnyen po 'di rnyed sla bas kyang dbang rtul la bstan pa yin no// rim lnga las kyang*/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs// zhes gsungs la/ 'di bskyed pa'i rim pa kho nas grol bar byed mi nus te/ de la legs par goms nas rdzogs rim la slob dgos pas so// rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dkyil 'khor la sogs las gang yin// bcos ma'i sems kyis gang byed pa// phyi rol las rnams gsal byed pas// dang po'i las can rnams la bsngags// dngos grub de kun 'dir gnas pas// rgyal ba'i dngos nyid rigs la min// zhes pas rdzogs rim la zhugs pa nas bskyed rim mi dgos par dor chog pa rang bzhin yongs su shes nus na nam nus pa de tsam nas sngags la sogs pa'i dngos grub don gnyer des de ma grub kyang rdzogs rim la 'jug ste dngos grub de 'dir zhar las grub bo// gal te rang bzhin yongs su shes par mi nus na gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub de ma grub kyi bar de ga rang gis bsgrub dgos par bstan to// de'i tshe shi na skye ba rting ma sogs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skal ldan du 'gyur ro// de bas na bskyed rim gyi mthar thug 'di rjes su dpag pa'i sgom pa'i mngon sum gyi bdag byin rlabs te/

phyi ma 'di lha'i de kho na nyid dngos ma yin/ rgyu mtshan brtag gnyis las/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes pa de ltar rdo rje can gyi srid pa gsum po mtha' dag rnams kyang dkyil 'khor rnam par gsungs// phyi dang lus dang gzhan la yang ni spro dang sdud pa dag la dngos po'i skye ba yang dag gnas// de la rtag pa mkha' yi rdo rje rnam gsum srid pa la gnas mi rtag nyid du 'gyur ma yin// 'byung po'i tshogs ni rtag pa min par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po mig 'phrul ji bzhin nyid du'o// zhes pas so// yang brtag gnyis las// bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa gnyis// rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// zhes gsungs pa ni rang bzhin yongs su shes nus pa de'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ji ltar bsgoms kyin rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ches lhag pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba ni/ bud shing mang gin me che ba'i dpe 'od srung gyis zhus pa'i mdor gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang sa ra has/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// klog pa de yin 'dzin dang sgom pa'ang de// bstan bcos snying la 'chad pa'ang de yin no// zhes dang*/ ji srid sems las rnam 'phros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po rtse ba bzhin no// mdor na bskyed rim nas nges par 'jug dgos par 'dod pa dang*/ bskyed rim rtog sgom yin pas 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur gtan mi dgos par 'dod pa rnams ni ngal ba kho na ste phyogs gcig pa'i blos thams cad gzhal bar sems pas nam mkha' 'dom gyis 'jal ba bzhin no// 'o na gang yin zhe na gdul bya'i dbang gis so// nang le'i lta ba mdor bsdus gsungs pa'i dgos pa mu stegs byed nas rnal 'byor spyod pa man sun phyung*// dbu ma 'thad par 'jog pa'ang*/

de'i lta bas zin pas na bya ba dang las thams cad 'khor bar mi 'ching ba'i khar grol ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ro zhes pa dang*/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi las mi srid pa dang theg pa gsum las gzhan pa'i bzhi pa dang*/ sde snod gsum las gzhan pa'i bzhi pa med par 'chad pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje snying pos/ sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang*// lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min// zhes pas so// 'o na dpung bzang las/ rig 'dzin sde snod du ni ngas bshad do// zhes gsungs pa ji ltar 'grel zhe na/ sde snod gsum ka rig 'dzin du bsdu ba'i phyir te/ rdo ba'i rigs kyi bye brag zhig /bzhu ba gser dngul zangs lcags 'gyur// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa yis// kun kyang gser du bsgyur ba ltar// rigs can gsum gyi sdom pa yang*// dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na// rig pa 'dzin pa zhes brjod do// zhes tshul khrims la bzhin zla stobs kyis shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin yang shes par bya'o// lung sde snod gsum yin pa'ang mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum bshad pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par phye ba gsang ba thams cad bshad pa'i mdzod las spyod byed du 'gro ba stong nyid la rag las par bstan pa'i skabs te bcu pa'o/// / gnyis pa stong nyid kyis zin pa'i rim 'jug gi lam dngos bshad pa la/ smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa gnyis/ dang po la dngos grub kyi 'byung khungs dpon slob kyi brtag pa/ dngos grub sgrub byed dkyil 'khor gyi rab dbye/ dngos grub kyi rgyur dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ don dam bsnyen par/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub slob dpon zhal gyi rjes 'brang par// ma lus rdo rje theg par thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs// de phyir slob ma dam pas bla ma gser bzhin du// yongs su brtags na sdig pa cung zad yod ma yin// zhes pas dngos grub 'grub mi 'grub kyi kha ma yin pas bla ma brtag pa gces pa yin la/

de yang*// dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg la lhag par gnas// de nyid sgom zhing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs// slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan// bdun rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o// zhes pa bla ma dam pa ste sa la rdo rje sems dpa'o// slob dpon de lta bu ni slob ma thams cad bsdu bar 'os te skal pa bzhin du khrid pa la mkhas pas so// de lta bu'i mchog gi mchog rnyed par dka' na slob ma so so la bla ma so sor bstan te/ slob dpon chen po klu'i byang chub gyis gsungs pa bzhin no// ji ltar zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje yi// theg par slob dpon rnam gnyis gsungs// gcig ni gsang sngags gtsor byed 'gyur// gcig ni bsam gtan la gzhol ba// zhes pa'o// sngar gyi lung ni bsam gtan gtso bor smos pa dang*/ sngags la gzhol ba gtso bor bstan pa ni/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyur med// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// snying rjer ldan zhing bstan chos mkhas// de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes// dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas// gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te// zhes pa/ sngags zhes pa sngags kyi dngos grub pa'i thabs dang*/ rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes zhes pa zhi sogs kyi sbyor ba shes pa yin la/ de nyid bcu/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang*// gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang*// kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang*/ gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*// drag shul bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang*// rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub// gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no// dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*// stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang*// sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor dang*// slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa ni// phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no// zhes gsungs pa'o// de yang*/

gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring*/ dge tshul zhes bya de dag las// khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o// zhes gdam nga yod na de ltar bya ba med na khyim pa'ang rung ste/ rgyal ba'i skyes rabs na rngon pa la chos 'dug pa thos par mdzad pa lta bu'o// bsten du mi rung ba'i bla ma ni/ nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil gnon dam tshig rnam bral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med// slob ma rnams ni slu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas la sems nyams dbang ma bskur// longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa// de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya// zhes pa nyid do// slob dpon du gyur zin nas/ slob dpon yon tan blang bya yin// skyon ni nam yang min pa nyid// yon tan blangs pas dngos grub 'gyur// skyon brjod pa las dngos grub med// ces gsungs/ bla ma sangs rgyas su blta dgos/ de ltar mthong na ci gsungs tshad mar shes 'ong ba dpal nā ro pa lta bu'o// de tsa na 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyang bde blag tu rnyed pa yin no// dge slong gis slob dpon khyim pa bsten dgos pa byung na/ 'grel chen las 'dir/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams kyis dus gsum du rdo rje'i slob dpon la phyag 'tshal bar bya ste/ khyim pa dang gsar bu pa rnams la ni dam pa'i chos 'chad pa'i tshe ma gtogs par ma yin no zhes te 'dul ba'i bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad pa'o// slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes// thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus shing g.yo ba min pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed// gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma de nyid bla ma shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdu bya ba// shes rab dbang la sogs pa'i rgyur te zhes pa ni bsam gtan la gzhol ba'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid dang*/

gzhan zhes bya ba slar yang 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur/ zhes pa sngags la gzhol ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o// de yang 'grel chen las/ da ni zab cing zhes pa la sogs pas shes rab ye shes la sogs pa'i dbang gi don tu slob ma dam pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs te/ 'dir sngags kyi tshul la slob ma rnam pa gnyis te/ gcig ni phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub pa don du gnyer ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa don du gnyer ba'o// gang phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub pa don du gnyer ba de ni stong pa nyid kyi lam bsgom pa'i don du bum pa dang gsang ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis yang dag par bsdu bar bya'o// gang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa don du gnyer ba de ni sngags dang phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i don du dbang bdun gyis yang dag par bsdu bar bya ba ste/ 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur zhes so// tha ma ni dbang gis yang dag par bsdu bar bya ba ni ma yin te/ dge bsnyen kyi bslab pas yang dag par bsdu bar bya'o zhes pas bskyed rim dgos pa dang mi dgos pa 'di lta bur phye ste gsungs rung 'tshang rgya ba la nges par bskyed rim dgos so snyam pa dang*/ mi 'dod nas rtsod pa don med/ rtsa ba'i 'gag rim 'jug pa dang cig car ba'i khyad du snang*/ cig car ba la yang nges par mi dgos pa tsam ston pa yin gyis/ des de nyams su blangs kyang gnod par ci 'gyur te/ 'dod chags 'dod chags kyis sbyong ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa dngos grub sgrub byed dkyil 'khor gyi rab dbye la dngos dang rnam dag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'grel chen las/ rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa/ ji ltar shes par bya zhe na brjod par bya ste/ 'dir mchod rten gyi phyi rol rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnam par dag pas ka ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/

phyogs bzhi rnams su thur ma bdun gyi dbye bas shar du khyab 'jug gis khyer nas 'ongs pa dang*/ lhor kārti ka yis dang*/ nub tu tshangs pas dang*/ byang du bde byed kyis khyer te 'ongs pa dag gtsugs pa dag gang yin pa des na mchod rten gyi phyi rol tu rgyu skar gyi rnam par dbye bas mchod rten gyi nang gi dkyil 'khor ni dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor ro zhes gsungs pas/ drug gi rnam par dbye ba zhes pa'ang ka ba bdun re yod pa'i gcig zur la yod pas logs la drug drug byung ba de la dgongs pa yin no// yang 'og gi dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug dang ldan pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje bcu drug rnam par dag pas so zhes so// 'og gi dkyil 'khor 'di mtshan brjod dang*/ 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor rgyud nas gsungs pa'i chos dbyings gsung dbang la 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ sku gsung thugs zhes sngar gsungs pa dang*/ dpal ldan dri med gsung gi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur nas// zhes dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rang la gsungs pa yin no// de ka yang*/ 'ga' zhig gsungs rdo rje'i gtso bor gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor la chos dbyings gsung dbang dang*/ thugs rdo rje gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje dbyings zhes btags pa yin no zhes zer yang 'di'i rdo rje dbyings dang*/ chos dbyings gsung dbang dang*/ dus kyis 'khor lo don gcig ka'o// de yang*/ nang le'i tshigs bcad lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa sogs shlo ka bcu dang*/ der ma tshang ba ye shes kyi le'us kha bskang ste bshad par bya ste/ lo brgya'i ye shes kyi cha bsags pa'i lo gsum phyogs gsum lhar bstan pa/ lo dang po sku rdo rje/ gnyis pa gsung rdo rje/ gsum pa thugs rdo rje// de yang*/ snying stobs dag pa/ rdul dag pa/ mun pa dag pa'o// lo gsum po de la lho bgrod gsum byang bgrod gsum ste/

rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa thabs shes rigs drug go /lo re khyim zhag sum brgya drug cus bsgyur bas stong brgyad cu byung*/ de zla ba'i dbye ba sum cus bgos pas so drug thob pa ni zla ba so drug de yang rnal 'byor ma'i rigs sum cu rtsa drug gam/ rnal 'byor pha'i rigs sum cu rtsa drug go /stong brgyad cu de la gza' bdun gyis bgos pas brgya lnga bcu rtsa bzhi 'thob/ de dus kyi 'khor lo padma gdan can gyi lha grangs/ lhag mar gnyis lus pa kun khyab kyi gtso bo yab yum/ bsdoms pas brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug phyogs kyi zhag bco lngas stong brgyad cu la bgos pas bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'thob/ 'khor lo sdom chen gyi lha grangs/ de'i steng du gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ dbu ma'i phyogs gsum gyi zhag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga la dus sbyor bcu gnyis pa re yod pas des bsgyur bas zhag gi yan lag dus sbyor lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu byung*/ de la sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum las bug pa rig byed de lha zhe dgu ma/ 'byung ba rgya mtsho zhe lnga ma/ me dang chu gter zhe gsum ma/ de rnams bsdoms pas lha yab yum zung brgya dang sum cu rtsa bdun 'byung*/ de thabs shes gnyis kyis bsgyur bas lha re re ba nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi'o// gsang ba 'dus pa la/ dus kyi dbye ba zhes pas rigs drug byung*/ de yang de nyid ces pa lha nyer lnga ma/ de las drug gi dman pa lha bcu dgu ma/ nyer lnga'i phyed phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ bcu dgu'i phyed phyed bcas dgu'i phyed ma 'di phyed dang bcu gsum gyi phyed ma la bsres pas lha bcu gsum ma dang lha dgu ma gnyis/ slar yang bsres pa dag ni zhes pas bcu gsum dang bcu dgu ma bsres pas lha so gnyis ma/ bug pa de nyid bsres pas lha so bzhi ma/ de ltar 'dus pa'i lha yab yum zung brgya dang so gnyis byung*/ de thabs shes rab kyis bsgyur bas lha re re ba nyis brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// 'dus pa dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dril ba'i lha lnga brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad/

kun khyab kyi gtso bo yab yum bsnan pas lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu ni phyogs zhag gi dus sbyor gyi grangs so// phyogs zhag zhe lnga la gza' bdun gyis bgos pas drug thob pa ni phyag rgya drug gi lha/ lhag ma gsum byung ba ni sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rgyas btab kyi lha ste shes rab kyi rgyud pa dang*/ de'i shugs kyis thabs rgyud dus sbyor gsum dang*/ snying stobs rdul mun dag pa'o// de dag gi steng du sdom pa chung ba bsnan pa la/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis zhes brjod do/ dang po la padma'i lte ba'i lha ni/ nus ma bcu/ gtsug tor can thugs dang sku dkyil gyi khro bo bcu dang*/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang gyur ma sogs gshegs ma lnga dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs sems ma drug sa snying sogs sems dpa' drug drug gnyis zhes pa tshes lha'i gtso bo bcu gnyis/ rnal 'byor ma gsung dkyil gyi gtso mo brgyad/ klu brgyad/ gtum mo brgyad/ srid par nyis 'gyur zhes pa phyi 'jig rten nang lus la'ang sbyar du rung ba/ 'di thams cad bsdus na lha zung bdun cu rtsa brgyad/ de thabs shes gnyis kyis bsgyur bas brgya nga drug de yang cha gsum du byas nas nyi ma'i phyogs la sum gnyis kyi grangs lha brgya dang bzhi/ zla ba'i cha la sum cha'i grangs lnga bcu rtsa gnyis/ de dag padma'i gdan can zhes pa ni/ phal cher padma'i lte ba la gnas pa yin la/ gzhan 'byung ba dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ shing rta la gnas pa zla stobs kyis drangs pa kha cig go /nus ma rnams 'dab mar gnas so snyam na/ de ni gtso bo dang sbyor ba'i tshe lte bar gnas pa yang yin no zhes gsungs so// nyi ma'i ye shes kyi cha 'bring zla ba gcig na chu tshod drug cur 'gyur/ de yang zhib mor brtsis na zhag so gnyis na zhag gcig de'i chu tshod drug cu/ de'i steng du dus sbyor bsres pa ste thun mtshams bzhi bsres pas 'dab ma'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/

de thabs shes gnyis kyis bsgyur bas lha brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung*/ lo'i khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu tshes lha'i gtso bo bcu gnyis kyi dod por mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis dang bcas pa'i tshes lha sum brgya drug cu/ de thabs shes kyis phye bas nyis 'gyur song bas bdun brgya nyi shu'i grangs su 'gyur/ gong gi lha mtha' dag dang*/ de'i steng du mngon brjod kyi lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ 'di sdom chen gyi lhar bzhed pa dang*/ rong pa shes rab seng ges 'dod phyir dod kyi lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis la mdzad/ snga ma de legs par sems so// de'i steng du phyag drug gi lha/ gtso bo yab yum kun khyab yin pas thabs rgyud kyi lha'i kha skong du byas nas padma'i gdan can gyi lha brgya nga bzhi/ gsung gi 'dab ma'i lha brgya nyer brgyad/ tshes lha'i bdun brgya nyi shu/ mngon brjod kyi bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ phyag rgya'i lha drug ste stong brgyad cu byung ba ni sngar lo gsum gyi zhag dang sbyar ba'o// de ltar lo dang phyogs kyi lha 'am shes rab dang pha'i rgyud kyi lha kun bsdoms pas stong drug brgya nyi shu byung ba ni rgyu skar nyer bdun re re 'ang chu tshod drug cu'i bdag nyid yin pas/ de drug cus bsgyur bas stong drug brgya dang nyi shu 'byung ba dang dag pa sbyor ro// shes rab thabs dag mtshan mo nyin mor 'gyur ba mnyam pa'i cha ste mtshan mo phyed dang nyin phyed la'o sogs kyis don/ phyir rgyu skar gyi chu tshod stong drug brgya nyi shu la gza' rnams longs spyod pa bzhin du nang du nyin mtshan nyin mo shes rab kyi lha stong brgyad cu/ mtshan mo thabs kyi lha lnga brgya bzhi bcu/ gzhan sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyis longs spyod pa'o// slar yang de las 'khor lo dag gi rtsa rnams de bzhin nyid// ces sogs kyi lte ba'i 'khor lo lus/

gsang ba'i 'khor lo ngag nor bu thugs kyi thig le 'dzin pa'i rtsa ste/ dbang mdor bstan las/ nor bu thugs dang gsang ba gsungs// lte bar sku ni bde chen phyir// zhes so// steng du nyi zla sgra gcan 'og tu bshang gci khu ba 'bab pa rigs drug gsang gnas kyi nang skor gyi rtsa 'dab drug de'i bar skor bcu/ lnga ba'i nang skor gyi 'pho chen bcu gnyis kyi rtsa/ snying ka'i thun brgyad de so drug rigs so drug yang lte ba'i bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni phung po'i rang bzhin can drug khams kyi/ dbang po'i/ yul gyi/ las dbang gi bya ba'i rang bzhin can drug drug ste so drug de rnams la brten pa'i rlung gzugs phung*/ de bzhin tshor 'du/ 'du byed rnam shes ye shes 'jug par byed pa drug drug ste so drug rten dang brten pa'i dbye ba des rigs bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ thun mtshams bzhi dag pa'i gtsug tor 'dab ma bzhi/ thun brgyad gza' brgyad dag pas snying ka'i rtsa brgyad/ thun phyed dam tshes bcu drug dag pas spyi bor bcu drug rgyu skar nyer brgyad dbyug gu'i skar ma bzhi dag pas mgrin par so gnyis/ chu tshod drug cu stong pa'i thob skal bzhi dang bcas pa dag pas lte ba'i phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi khams so gnyis dag pa'i gsang gnas so gnyis padma gdan can gyi lha'o// gsang gnas kyi nang gi drug 'khor lo drug 'gog pa/ bar skor bcu yul 'dzin pa'i rtsa 'gog pa/ 'dus pa'i rang bzhin de nyis 'gyur/ gtsug tor dang dpral ba'i nyi shu bad kan/ de nyis 'gyur mgrin snying gi rtsa bzhi bcu mkhris pa/ de nyis 'gyur/ lte ba dang gsang ba'i phyi skor dril bas rtsa brgyad cu rlung gi cha/ de ltar rtsa brgya dang nga drug de dag tha mal pa la 'chi ba ster/ rnal 'byor dang ldan pa la thar pa ster/ de'i steng du rigs drug gi rtsa bsnan pa de rnams la brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis byung*/ rlung bcus sam phung khams bcus bsgyur na stong drug brgya nyi shu 'byung*/

de dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha'o// dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi lha stong drug brgya nyi shu la sum cus bgos pas lha lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ de gsum gyi bsgyur bas brgya dang drug cu rtsa gnyis 'byung*/ de padma'i gdan can gyi lha brgya nga bzhi/ kun khyab gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ phyag rgya drug dang bcas pa'i grangs so// yang na stong drug brgya nyi shu la snying ga'i rtsa bcus bgos pa brgya re gnyis thob ste gnad gcig de ltar nang ler gsungs pa yin la/ ye ler shes rab gyi rgyun sdom pa chung ba'i lha shar zhal nas spros tshul/ gsang 'dus rigs drug lho zhal/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum byang zhal/ sdom pa chen po nub zhal nas spro tshul/ tshigs bcad bcu gsum pa nas zhe gcig pa'i bar gyis gsungs pa'i don/ skyes pa la lo bcu drug pa'i mthar khams smin pas sems kyis rnam pa sna tshogs spro bar byed pa bzhin du/ gtso bo'i dpral ba'i 'khor lo chu khams las 'od dpag med sogs lha dkar po/ snying ka rlung las don grub sogs nag po/ mgrin pa me las rin 'byung sogs dmar po/ lte ba sa las rnam snang sogs ser po/ gtsug tor nam mkha' las mi skyod pa sogs ljang khu/ gsang ba ye shes las rdor sems sogs sngon po rnams so// 'dir sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rgyas 'debs la rnam snang dkar po/ snang mtha' dmar po/ mi bskyod pa nag po/ rdor sems ser por bshad pa'ang byung ste/ khams kyi dag pa las so// sdom pa chung ngu'i dkyil 'khor la/ rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha gnyis/ dang po ni/ phyi nas ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga ldan/ nang shar nag lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser po/ rtsa thig la reg pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po padma'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang du thugs 'khor nag po rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can/

'khor lo re la cha phran drug re yod pa'i phyi nas cha phran gnyis 'phreng ba/ bzhi rtsibs/ de yang phyogs mtshams re re yod pas brgyad/ de'i nang du cha phran drug ni phyi ma bzhi la pad 'dab brgyad ljang kha nang gi gnyis lte ba/ gzhan dus 'khor dang 'dra'o// gdan ni ro/ rten pa lha gtso bo ni zhabs g.yon brkyang u ma dang dbang phyug brdzis pa/ sku mdog rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar/ g.yon dkar/ rgyab ser dus sbyor dag pa'i phyag bcu gnyis/ gzhan lū yi pa lta bu'o// rdo rje phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa ljang kha/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ lhor lā ma dmar mo/ nub tu dum skyes ma ser mo/ byang du gzugs can ma dkar mo/ de dag kyang sgrol ma/ gos dkar/ spyan ma/ mā ma ki bzhi yin no// 'khor lo gsum la rab gtum ma dang*/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa yab yum nyer bzhi/ khwa gdong ma sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ lha mo gzhan rnams kyang phyogs mdog de la mer gnas pa shar bzhin gyi mtshams lhag ma gtogs so// dpa' mo nyer bzhi gzugs rdo rje ma sogs drug shin tu sngon mo sogs khro skyes ma bcu/ tsar tsi ka sogs 'byung skyes ma brgyad dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rab gtum ma brgyad/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje dang ḍa ma ru/ dril bu dang kha ṭwaṃ ga bsnams pa/ de dag kyang phyi lhun po'i steng gi padma brgyad snying po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi gnas/ mtshams bzhi nye gnas thugs 'khor/ chu'i phyed nang ma/ shar dang lho zhing*/ nub dang byang nye zhing*/ dbang ldan dang rlung tshandho ha/ bden bral dang me nye tshan te gsung 'khor/ chu'i phyed phyi ma shar dang lho 'dus pa/ nub dang byang nye 'dus/ dbang ldan dang rlung dur khrod/ bden bral dang me nye ba'i dur khrod sku 'khor/ dmyal ba brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ de yang gnas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshang ba bzhin/

'dzam bu gling dang*/ yul re re dang*/ grong khyer re rer yang tshang zhing*/ de dag na 'khor lo de dag gi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang yod par shes par bya'o// gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la rten nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad cha phran bcu gnyis la bya ste/ dbus nas phyogs gcig la gtso bo'i gnas cha phran gsum/ rdo rje'i gdung ngam ka ba'i gnas la cha phran phyed dang gnyis/ sangs rgyas bzhi'i gnas la cha phran drug phyi'i gdung zlum po la phyed gnyis/ ka gdung gi sa la gtso bo'i mtshan ma rdo rje bri/ zlum po'i phyi nas rtsa thig gi bar gyi cha phran bcu gnyis la phyed mar bgos nas nang mar tshon sa/ phyi ma lha snam/ yang na dus 'khor ltar cha phran bdun/ lha snam la bzhi/ dpang chung la gcig go gzhan sdom chung bzhin/ gdan dpa' bo gcig pa byed na khu rdul dag pa'i zla nyi/ lha dgu ma zla rkang dang po'i chu tshod lnga 'am gzugs sogs yon tan lnga dag pa'i zla gdan/ yum bzhi rnam snang gi gdan/ rdul mun snying stobs kyi yon tan gsum de dag cha mnyam pa'i skabs dag pa'i gdan bzhi gtso bor rin 'byung snang mtha' don grub kyi gdan/ bcu gsum ma de'i steng du nyi ma'i rim pa'i snga rkang la bu lon 'phel phyi rkang la bu lon 'grib/ rim min gyi snga rkang la nor 'phel phyi rkang la nor 'grib pa dbye bas nyi gdan bzhi sgo'i khro bo'i gdan/ lha bcu dgu ma la res gza' bdun dag pa'i nyi gdan bdun/ sgo'i khro bo dang rin 'byung sogs kyi gdan yar ngo'i rdzogs pa bcu gnyis dag pa'i zla gdan bcu gnyis/ gtso bo rnam snang yum bzhi sems ma drug rnams kyi gdan/ lha nyer lnga ma la yar ngo'i rdzogs pa bcu gnyis kyi dag pa'i zla gdan bcu gnyis sems dpa' drug sems ma drug gi gdan/ mar ngo'i rdzogs pa bcu gnyis dag pa'i nyi gdan bcu gnyis/ gshegs pa bzhi/ yum bzhi khro bo bzhi'i gdan/ gtso bo la zla nyi gang rung*/

lha so gnyis ma la nyer lnga'i steng du gza' bdun dag pa'i nyi gdan bdun te/ de ltar nyi gdan nyi shu ni khro bo bcu gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas lnga yum bzhi/ zla gdan bcu gnyis ni sems dpa' drug sems ma drug gis so// lha so bzhi ma la de'i steng du mnyam mo sna bug g.yas nas srog 'gro ba'i nyi gdan/ sna bug g.yon nas srog 'gro ba'i zla gdan/ dzambha la yab yum gyi gdan brten pa ni/ de yang phung po lnga dag pa rigs lnga/ khams bzhi yum bzhi/ lha dgu de'i steng sgo skyong khri bo bzhi bsnan pas bcu gsum/ de'i steng du yul drug dag pa'i sems ma drug bsnan pas bcu dgu de'i steng du ra ba'i rtsig pa la nye ba'i lha rnams la gnas pa'i sems dpa' drug ste nyer lnga/ de'i steng du zur gyi khro bo bzhi steng 'og gnyis te drug gtso bo yab yum tha dad du bgrangs pas lha so gnyis/ gong du khro bo bcu gcig ces pa gtso bo khro chags yin pas de bgrangs pa'o// khro bo bcu sbyang gzhi ni/ las dbang lnga/ de'i yul bya ba lnga'o// de'i steng du dzambha la yab yum bsnan pas so bzhi/ mchog gi dbang po dang dga' ba'i bya ba dag pa'o// dus gyi rtsa dbu ma ni dbus kyi gtso bo nyid kyi sbyang gzhi/ rdul mun snying stobs dag pas zhal gsum/ yul drug dag pas phyag drug lus kyi mdzod drug dag pas phyag mtshan drug ste/ g.yas na rdo rje padma 'khor lo/ g.yon na dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dang po'i gnas su gzhan byung na de'i gnas su rdo rje 'gro zhing dbus su gtso bo 'phos na de'i gnas su mi bskyod pa 'gro'o// sku mdog gsal ka ma byung yang dus 'khor bzhin bla mas bzhed do// 'dus pa drug po 'di slob dpon tha ga nas lha dgu ma/ ind+ra bhū tis bcu gsum ma/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs bcu dgu ma/ slob dpon mgrin pa gsum pas nyer lnga ma/ klu sgrub kyis so gnyis ma/

kun snying gis so bzhi ma bshad pa dang lha grangs mthun ngo bo gcig kyang dkyil 'khor sogs ma mthun te 'di ni dus 'khor dang 'dra ba nyid do zhes bu ston gyis so// sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum gyi rten ni/ dbus nas bde gshegs 'phar ma yan la cha phran brgyad/ de nas rtsa thig gi bar la bcu drug yod pas tshangs thig nas cha phran gnyis la gtso bo'i gnas/ gcig rdor 'phreng*/ de nas bzhi bde gshegs 'phar ma'i gnas/ gcig rdor 'phreng*/ thams cad dbyibs gru bzhi'o// des sum cha song*/ de nas sum gnyis la bzhi sgra rdo rje ma sogs kyi gnas/ gcig rdor 'phreng*/ de nas bzhi khro bo/ gcig rdor 'phreng*/ yang bzhi sems dpa' bcu drug gi gnas/ gcig rdor 'phreng*/ thams cad gru bzhi/ lhag ma gcig tshon sa/ gzhan dus 'khor dang 'dra/ gdan zhe gsum ma la yar ngo'i rdzogs pa bcu gnyis mar ngo'i bcu gnyis te zla nyi nyer bzhi de'i steng du gza' bdun dag pa'i nyi ma/ nyi rkang gi chu tshod bcu gcig dag pa'i nyi gdan bcu gcig yang na bsam pa'i zla gdan bcu gcig gtso bo la gang rung*/ de las nyi gdan sum cu ni yum bzhi/ khro bo bcu/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi gdan/ zla gdan bcu gsum ni rigs lnga/ rdo rje ma brgyad kyi gdan zhe lnga ma la/ de'i steng du rkang 'dzin mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa'i dag pas zla gdan gnyis bsnan pa/ zhe dgu ma la nyi rkang gi bu lon 'phel 'grib gnyis nor 'phel 'grib gnyis te bzhi dag pa'i nyi gdan bzhi 'am/ bsam pa'i dbang gis zla gdan bzhi'o// gtso bo gdan gang rung brten pa lha ni dbus kyi bde gshegs 'phar ma la le'u tshe dgur byas pa'i bar ka bas bcad pa/ sangs rgyas lnga/ yum bzhi/ 'phar ma/ gzhan la sgra rdo rje ma sogs brgyad/ ming gzhan sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin chen rdo rje ma/ chos kyi rdo rje ma/ las kyi rdo rje ma/ tsunda/ rin chen skar mda'/ khro gnyer can/

rin chen lcags sgrog ma zhes bya'o// de'i phyir snam bu la phyogs bcur khro bo bcu/ steng gi khro bo/ shar gyi shar/ 'og nub kyi nub/ de'i phyi rol ra ba'i rtsig pa la nye ba'i snam bu shar la/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ spos kyi glang po/ ye shes tog bzhi/ lhor bzang skyong blo gros rgya mtsho/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa bzhi/ nub tu mthu chen thob/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan mun 'joms/ dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi/ byang du zla 'od/ 'od dpag med/ nam mkha' mdzod/ sgrib sel bzhi'o// 'dus pa ltar zhal gsum phyag drug phyogs kyi mdog can no// 'khor lo sdom pa che ba'i dkyil 'khor la rten ni tshangs thig nas phyogs kyi rtsa thig gi bar la khru bzhi yod pas sor mo zhe brgyad/ sor phyed du btang bas dgu bcu rtsa drug phyi'i 'jig rten gyi sa chu me dang g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor dang sbyar nas snying po nas rang sor drug tu bgos nas drug tshan dang po la dga' ba'i 'khor lo bya ste/ de yang dbus nas gnyis sor gnyis bskor ba lte ba/ de nas bzhis pad 'dab bcu drug gnyis pa sogs drug la sor bzhis 'khor lo'i sa/ sor gnyis la mu khyud/ de yang ye shes kyi 'khor lo la gri gug sa la 'khor lo/ chu la padma/ me la rin po che/ rlung la ral gri/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'o// drug tshan brgyad pa tshon sa/ sor bcu gnyis kyis sgo dang sgo khyud dang sgo logs sgo 'gram bya zhing*/ sor drug res kha khyer dang do shal gyi sa/ sor gsum gyis phyi nas rim pa bzhin ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i re khā/ sor gsum gyis do shal gyi rtsa bar rin po che'i snam bu dmar po/ sor bcu gnyis pa sum 'gyur gyis ka ba'i steng du rta babs so// phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir sgo re re ste brgyad do// rtsa thig zlum po yin no// sgo rta babs phyogs mdog dus 'khor bzhin no// ste ba ljang khu la zla ba dang steng du nyi ma/

ye shes kyi 'khor lo sngon po gzhi ljang kha/ sa'i gzhi nag po/ chu'i gzhi dmar po/ me'i gzhi dkar po/ rlung gi gzhi ser po/ nam mkha'i gzhi sngon po 'byung ba'i 'khor lo'i phreng ba rang rang gi mdog sgo brgyad kyi so so'i dbus su sor drug gi tshad kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtsig pa'i nang rol tshon sa'i steng du sngar dang tshad mtshungs pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bcu drug 'god par bu ston gyi gsung dharma shrī pa'i zin bris su byung*/ gzhan phyi'i 'dod snam la 'god par byed do// brten pa ni snying po'i padma'i lha mo brgyad ni phyogs mtshams su du ba ma sogs brgyad/ bar gyi 'dab ma brgyad la thod pa bdun rtsi'i ros gang ba brgyad/ 'khor lo drug gi rtsibs brgyad po rnams la gnas dang nye gnas la sogs par bzhugs pa'i lha mo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang dpa' bo/ de mnyam phyi rol tu shar gyi ka ba'i 'og gi g.yon dang g.yas su stobs rgyu dang padma nag po/ me mtshams kyi ka ba'i 'og g.yas g.yon du dri chab ma dang 'phreng ba ma ste/ phyogs su glu dang mtshams su sgeg sogs kyi lha mo brgyad/ rta babs kyi phyir sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rdo rje'i ra ba 'od zer 'bar ba dus 'khor bzhin rang rang gi tshad dang ldan pa'o// gtso bo sdom chen ni zhal bzhi sogs mtshungs par ma zad don rdo rje shugs rang ngo zhes gsung ste/ 'grel chen las/ bcom ldan 'das ni thig le bzhi 'dzin pa'i phyir zhal bzhi pa'o// phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'gog pa'i phyir phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// lhag pa'i zla ba'i phyogs gnyis 'gog pa'i phyir gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag ste sngar gsungs pa'i rdo rje shugs so// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal gcig ni stong pa nyid do// phyag gnyis ni mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dag pa'o// gri gug dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ thod pa la sogs pa ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// du ba ma sogs zhal gcig phyag gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa/

bar gyi thod par nub gnyis su bshang ba/ byang gnyis su gci ba/ lho gnyis su khrag shar gnyis su mi shas gang ba/ lha rnams kyi phyag gi thod pa ni bdud rtsi'i khu bas gang ba/ 'di kun nas thabs shes gnyis kar bde ba'i snyoms par zhugs pa gtso bo'i yin pa'i phyir dga' ba'i 'khor lo lha mo phyogs mdog lha mo gzhan rnams g.yas brkyang g.yon thod pa g.yas gri gug yab khro bo rnams zhal gnyis rtsa ba'i zhal dang rgyas 'debs kyi zhal/ phyag bzhi g.yas rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dril bu dang kha ṭwāṃ/ glu dang sgeg mo dus 'khor bzhin lha mo rnams gcer bu skra grol ba/ rkang pa dril g.yer/ 'og pag dpral bar dar dpyangs/ phyag rgya lnga/ mgo 'phreng thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can no// mkha' 'gro rnams mgo bor cod pan rdo rje'i dar dpyangs spyi bor nor bu phyag rgya drug mgo bo lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba/ 'tshogs ma'i g.yon du zla phyed/ stag sham sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o// de ni chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gam rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po de yang rdul tshon dang*/ lus dang bha ga dang*/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor te rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ba yin la/ de las dang po ni/ 'grel chen las/ da ni sems can rnams kyis bsod nams dang ye shes thob par bya ba dang*/ slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba sbyin pa dang*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa bya ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i bden pas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug par de nyid bcu dang yang dag par ldan pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol zhes dang*/ rgyu des na zla ba bzang pos gsol ba btab pa 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i don dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i don dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi don du ni ma yin no zhes 'byung bas/

las kyi rim pa rgyas pa dgos pa ni de'i ngo kho na'o/ 'dir dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan kho nas smin par byed dgos zer ba'ang phyogs gcig pa'i blo skyon can du rtogs so// gang zag de'i rigs la'ang 'byor ldan dang kun spangs kyi tshul gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma ni 'grel chen las/ kun spangs kyi slob ma rnams la ni mchod pa nges pa med cing de dag la bstan pa'i don du bla ma rnams la yang nges pa med de/ gang gi phyir sangs rgyas dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang bsam pa 'dzin par byed pa ste mchod pa la sogs pa'i dngos po 'dzin par byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs la/ kun spangs 'di'i dbang du byas nas de nyid du/ nag pa'i nya la dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sam/ yang na dkyil 'khor bris pa med par yang sogs kyis gsungs so// de lta bu'i gang zag la dbang bskur ba na dbang rdzas thams cad yid kyis bsgoms te tshig tsam gyis dbang bskur bas chog ste/ rdo rje 'phreng bar/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhes sam gzhan du mngon par rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhes gsungs te/ de ltar dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel par/ nā ro pa chen pos kyang gsungs so// des na 'byor ldan gyi dbang du byas nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang blos bslang ras bris la sogs bshad pa'o// gzhal yas khang gi gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje la byed pa mang du bshad pa dang mi 'dra/ 'dir ni rdo rje'i gzhi/ dper na sa men bsgrigs pa'i zhal ba lta bur byas pa'i steng du bsgom pa yin/ de yang rtsa rgyud las/ gru bzhi mnyam pa'i sa dag la/ bcu drug cha ru byas nas ni// sku yi dkyil 'khor dor bya ste// slar yang cha ni bcu drug pa// gsung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bya// de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor dag /dor nas cha ni bcu drug pa// slar yang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bya// de ltar phyogs gsum yang dag dag

/dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid do// zhes pa lag len du/ mnyam pa gru bzhi bcu drug cha// kun la'o cha re sor phyed skur// bcu gnyis gsung drug thugs kyi gsum// dang po phyed phyi gnyis pa bzhir// lnga pa dbus dor drug phyed phyi// sgo yang cha phran drug tu bya// sgo gsum la ni rta babs so// drug dang phyed lnga phyed bzhi gnyis// yang gnyis 'og nas rim bzhin bya// snam bu myos srung re re'i 'o// sor phyed pa re phyed la phyed// rgyar ni nyer bzhi bcu drug dang*// bco brgyad bcu gnyis bco lnga brgyad// bar ma gru bzhi gsum par ka /gcig dang chas dman phyogs mthar brgyan// har mi'i rgyar brgyad bum pa gnyis// lter drug zlum gcig bzhi bdun bzhi// bdun pa'i phyi nang re khā bzhi// rta babs rtse nas cha phran ni// gsum drug drug drug gsum drug bskor// zhes pa nyid de yang rdo rje 'phreng ba nang ma'i sa gzhi ljang kha 'am sngon po/ shar nag lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser po/ padma ljang khu/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba nang ma nag po/ phyi ma ljang*/ ka ba gnyis po rigs kyi mtshan mas brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i padma'i phyi zur bzhi dbang ldan du dung dkar/ lhor gaṇḍi dmar po/ mer nor bu nag po/ rlung dpag bsam ser po/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i bar gyi bum pa dkar po/ kha rgyan pad gdan dang bcas pa/ gshegs pa/ sems dpa'/ lho nub kyi khro bo'i gdan pad dkar nyi mar dmar po gzhan rnams pad dkar zla dmar/ lha'i snam bu dkar po/ kha khyer dkar po/ mun pa nag po/ ba ku lī mda' yab nag po la de dag bskor/ rta babs kyi ka ba ser po/ rta babs sna tshogs mdog phyi zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsung la pad 'dab brgyad/ sku la bzhi brgyad bcu drug pa snam bu'i steng gi padma rnams phyogs mdog mtshams dkar po/ sku'i rta babs kyi 'og tu 'byung ba sogs gdan/ phyi'i khor yug gis ser po la dbang ldan du zla ba/

bden bral du nyi ma/ chu dkar/ me dmar/ rlung nag me rlung gi mtshams su dur khrod kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phyogs dmar/ mtshams dmar ser bcu gnyis kyi tshad/ nam mkha' ljang khu g.yas g.yon du cha phran gsum dor ba'i dbus ma la rdo rje 'phreng ba/ de'i phyir 'od zer 'phro ba kha dog lnga pa/ sku'i mda' yab dang sa'i khor yug gi bar la bum sogs mchod rdzas/ rta babs kyi ka rgyan 'og ma glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge steng ma gnyis shā la bhañdzi ka ste gnod sbyin mo/ sku'i rta babs kyi lhag nas dbus ma'i shar du 'khor lo/ g.yas g.yon ri dwags/ lhor bum pa/ g.yas g.yon dung pad/ nub tu rnga bo che/ g.yas g.yon dbyug pa dang tho ba/ byang du dpag bsam gyi shing*/ g.yas g.yon du mi'am ci pho mo/ rta babs kyi snam bu la 'phyang ba'i dril bu dang me long*/ ba dan rnams dkar po/ kha cig padma'i lte bar gtso bo gtso mo thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan la srog chags byed/ rab gtum ma sogs 'khor med pas padma'i 'og tu sogs chags byed la/ rang lugs thams cad mtshungs par padma'i 'og tu srog chags byed pa yin te/ 'grel chen las/ tsa munḍi la sogs pa rnams kyi padma'i gdan rnams gsungs te/ 'dir shar du tsa muṇḍi ste yi dwags dmar po chen po'i gdan dang padma'i lte ba la'o zhes dang*/ dbang ler/ tsar tsi ka padma'i gdan yi dwags te/ de dag gi steng du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa de nyid rdul tshon gyis bri bar bya ste gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yi dwags ro langs mkha' lnging khyad/ khyu mchog glang*/ bhe runḍa bya'i rigs gcig mig sngon 'dre bya/ gshang gdong pha wang*/ 'ga' zhig las bya ma byi snga ma 'di la bshang gci sna nas 'byung ba yin pas der btags so// phag gdong ma'i gdan du dom zer ba 'dug kyang bu mchan du dred seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa ni sha ra bha ste rkang lag bzhi'i logs su spu skyes pa rtsal 'dab tu snang ba la btags par 'dug

mkha' lding mdog lnga pa ni/ dpyi man ser po/ de nas lte ba'i bar dkar po/ de nas mgrin pa'i bar dmar po smin ma'i bar nag po/ de nas spyi bo'i bar ljang khu'o// blos bslang ba'i tshe/ sku dkyil gyi rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi mtha'i bar dang*/ de sku'i 'dod snam gyi rmang nas rdo rje'i tog gi bar du khyer ba mnyam pa/ sku dkyil gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi de'i thog mda' yab dang bcas 'thon pa/ de'i rta babs dang rtse mnyam pa/ nang gi phyed kyi tshad du gsung dkyil 'degs pa'i gar bu de tshun sleb pa/ thugs dang bde chen dag la yang 'dra'o// bde chen gyi rdo rje'i 'phreng ba rtsig pa bzhin ma yin cog gu brtsigs lta bu'o// gnyis pa rnam dag bshad pa ni/ phyi 'jig rten dang*/ nang lus dang*/ gzhan chos kyi phung po dang sbyar ba'i tshul gsum/ dang po/ dbus nas sgo yi dang po'i mtshams ni nor gyi blo gros mar 'gyur sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyis bstan la/ tshangs thig nas thugs dkyil gyi sgo'i bar ni sa dkyil dang*/ de nas gsung gi rtsa thig gi bar ni lan tshwa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de nas gsung gi mda' bar ni me dkyil dang*/ de nas sku'i rtsa thig gi bar ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag bzhi pa dang sbyar ba'o// de yang sku dkyil la khru tshad stong yod rung gcig las med rung 'dra/ sku dkyil de'i rtsa thig nas nub kyi rtsa thig gi bar la dkyil 'khor de rang gi khru bzhir brtsis te bshad pa yin no// ji ltar rgya bzhin srid du yang sku dkyil gyi lte ba'i 'og gzhi nas ye shes nor bu'i tog gi rtse'i bar la ri rab kyi gtsug tor nas mgrin pa rdzogs pa yan thugs/ ri rab dang gsung 'byung bzhi'i dpangs dang sku dkyil sbyor ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sa'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyis don dkyil 'khor gyi ka ba rnams dang*/

nang gi rdo rje 'phreng ba gnyis dang*/ sa'i 'khor lo dang*/ rtsig pa rnams lus kyi rus pa rnam par dag pa/ sha khrag chu bshang ba rnams kyi dag pas shar lho nub byang du rdul tshon phyogs mdog mkhris pas nyi gdan/ bad kan gyis zla gdan/ rtsa rgyas dag pas padma/ sku'i rtsig pa lnga pa la sogs pa 'byung skyes lnga/ de bzhin 'byung ba'i rlung lnga dag pas gsung gi rtsig pa/ dus kyi rtsa dag pas gtso bo'i padma/ padma lhag ma rnams ro brkyang sogs rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ pags pa sa me khrag dang drod/ chu rdul/ bu ga bcu gnyis dag pas bden don bcu gnyis/ bu ga bcu gnyis ni/ kha sna mig rna ba gsum la gnyis gnyis te bu ga gci bshang khu ba'i bu ga gsum/ nu ma gnyis so// de ltar nyi ma'i dus sbyor gyi dbye bas sgo bcu gnyis/ zla ba'i cha'i dbye bas sgo lnga ste/ sku'i sgo lnga dbang po lnga/ gsung gi sgo lnga sgra 'byung ba'i gnas/ rkan/ spyi bo/ mchu/ so/ mgrin pa lnga/ thugs kyi sgo lnga/ kha/ bshang*/ gci/ khu/ gtsug tor te bco lnga dag pa/ de yang dkyil 'khor la steng 'og stong pa'i sgo gcig phyogs kyi sgo bzhi'o// nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa sogs ni so/ dur khrod brgyad/ rkang lag gi sor mo rnams kyi sen mo rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ me 'od ba spu rnam par dag pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun che// thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro// zhes sam/ tshangs zur gyi thig bzhi tshad med bzhi/ dkyil 'khor gyi gru bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ sgo bcu gnyis rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag pas rta babs bcu gnyis sa bcu gnyis/ dur khrod brgyad 'phags lam brgyad/ ka ba bcu drug stong nyid bcu drug sku gsung thugs ye shes bde chen lnga ste dkyil 'khor lnga brtsegs pa stong pa chen po'i khams lnga/ dkyil 'khor re la sgo khyud brgyad brgyad yod pa gzugs can gzugs la blta ba'i rnam par thar pa sogs brgyad/

sgo 'gram brgyad 'byung bzhi/ dri ro reg gzugs bzhi/ sgo logs brgyad yon tan brgyad kyi ngo bo/ tshon kha dog lnga ni tshul khrims kyi phung sogs lnga/ thugs dkyil gyi rtsig pa gsum theg pa gsum/ gsung dkyil gyi lnga dbang po lnga/ sku dkyil gyi lnga stobs lnga/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi kha khyer dpa' 'bar 'gro ba sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin nam gzungs gsum/ pha gu phar phyin/ dra ba ma 'dres pa'i chos/ dbang bcu dge bcu/ mda' yab rnam thar sgo bzhi/ zur gyi rgyal mtshan rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi/ me long yang dag spong bzhi/ rnga yab byang chub yan lag me tog gi 'phreng ba gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ 'dod snam gyi zur gyi rdo rje rgya gram bsdu ba bzhi/ sgo khyud kyi rin po che bden bzhi/ khor yug lnga mngon shes lnga/ rdo rje'i ra ba byang chub chen po/ me ri bde chen/ chos 'khor thugs rdo rje/ bum pa gsung*/ rnga bo che sku/ shing ye shes rdo rje/ nor bu thugs/ gaṇḍī gsung*/ dung sku/ shing ye shes so// nang lha'i dag pa ni/ lo gcig dag pa'i sku gcig bgrod pa gnyis dag pa'i zhabs gnyis/ dus gsum dag pa'i mgrin pa gsum/ dus bzhi dag pa'i zhal bzhi/ dus drug dag pa'i phrag pa drug zla ba bcu gnyis dag pa'i dpung pa bcu gnyis/ zla phyed nyer bzhi dag pa'i phyag nyer bzhi khyim zhag dag pa'i tshigs sum brgya drug cu/ gtso bo zhag gcig dag pa'i sku gcig nyin mtshan gyi cha gnyis dag pa'i zhabs gnyis/ thun mtshams bzhi dag pa'i zhal bzhi/ thun brgyad dag pa'i phyag brgyad/ gtso bo mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po/ yum rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid/ de gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa bde stong mi phyed pa'i don/ rlung bcu nus ma bcu/ nus ma brgyad las med na gnyis gang bsnan zhe na/ gtso mo la rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas sher phyin ma dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i cha gnyis 'dzin pas de gnyis bsnan no// nyon mongs pa lnga spangs pas drag po dkar po/

bdud bzhi bcom pas 'dod lha mnan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa ni rdul 'og tu brkyang ba dang khu ba gtsug tor du bskum pa'o// lus ngag yid ye shes kyi sgrib pa zad pa rim pa bzhin dung gaṇḍī nor bu dpag bsam/ rkang dag pa'i bum pa gnyis nas/ khrag dri chu dri chen dag pa'i bum pa gnyis/ de dag kyang lus kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis yod pas so// steng du khu ba 'ching pa rgyal ba'i bum pa/ 'og tu rdul mnan pa rnam rgyal bum pa/ phung po drug sha sogs/ khams drug sangs rgyas drug khams drug yum drug yul drug sems ma drug dbang po drug sems dpa' drug stobs lnga thugs dkyil gyi khro bo/ las dbang lnga dag pa sku dkyil/ dad sogs dbang po lnga dang las dbang gi bya ba lnga dag pas de dag gi yum khro mo bcu/ nyin gcig gi thun brgyad gsung dkyil gyi gtso bo brgyad/ chu tshod drug cu 'khor gyi lha mo stong pa'i rtsa bzhi dang lha mo bzhi ste drug cu rtsa bzhi/ nag pa sogs zla ba bcu gnyis dang tshes lha/ yud tsam sum cu rtsa gnyis/ klu dang bar gtum ma/ rtogs pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas bslang ba'i lus kyi bya ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'dod phyir 'dod/ skra grub pa/ ba spu 'byung ba'o// 'dod pa'i de nyid nyer bzhi gtso bo'i phyag mtshan/ de yang nam mkha'i khams rdo rjer sbyar ba sogs so// khams drug gzugs sogs yul drug dag pas phyi'i phyag rgya drug rdo rje bzhi dag pas nang gi phyag rgya bzhi/ g.yon rgyu dag pa g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas rgyu dag pa g.yas brkyang*/ mnyam rgyu mnyam pa'i rkang stabs/ nam mkha'i rlung sa ga rlung gi rlung zlum po/ me rlung rol pa'i/ chu rlung padma'i gdan/ sa rlung rdo rje'i gdan no// de ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor bshad pa yin no// dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par phye ba gsang ba thams cad bshad pa'i mdzod las/ dngos grub sgrub byed dkyil 'khor gyi rab dbye bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gcig pa'o/// /

gsum pa dngos grub kyi rgyu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bshad pa la/ dpa' bo yid 'ong las gsungs pa bzhin gyi dbang gi chings/ zhar la la rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ der/ dkyil 'khor yang ni rnam pa gnyis// lhag gnas dang ni mchod pa'o// lhag gnas la yang rnam gnyis te// rang don dang ni gzhan don no// mchod pa la yang rnam gnyis te// bdag bsgrub dang ni gzhan bsgrub bo// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang ni// yan lag la sogs thun mong ngo*// zhes gsungs pa don/ dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa rnam pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lhag gnas kyi yan lag lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro/ lhag gnas kyi dngos gzhi/ lhag gnas kyi rjes bzhi/ dang po ni/ slob mas bla ma legs par brtags shing*/ bla mas slob ma yongs su shes nas/ dang po/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i slob ma de sngags kyi dngos grub kyi snod rung du bya ba'i phyir dbang bdun tsam sbyin par bya ste/ nag pa'i mthar ni dkar po'i tshigs la gzhan la phan pa'i bla mas dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhengs byas nas// sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog pa'i dbang bdun rnams ni bsod nams don du bu rnams dag la sbyin par bya// de bas dbang bdun po 'dis gang zag de snod rung tsam du byed pas rdo rje'i theg pa la 'jug pa'i sgo yin gyis// 'di la dbang las bsgom par bya ba logs su bstan dgos te/ 'grel chen las/ 'dir dang por dbang bdun sbyin pa ni gzhug pa'i don dang*/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i don du ste/ de yis bsod nams kyi tshogs so// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud sde gzhan las/ slob ma'i dbang bskur ba tsam bshad pa dang gnad gcig 'di tsam thob pa rgyu rkyen tshogs cha tsam gyis smin pa ni yin no// des na/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam yin gyis// 'tshang rgya ba yi chos gzhan zhig

/bsgom rgyu logs na yod do zhes// blun po rnams kyis mun bsgoms byas// zhes pa'ang shākya seng ge la 'khu bar zad do// dbang de rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bskur bar bshad kyi/ lhag ma rnams dkyil 'khor de la ma bltos pas/ smin byed rdul tshon du bskur dgos zhes mgrin gcig tu smra ba'ang*/ lus kyi dbang po bha ga sems// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// gzhan pa tshon lnga ldan pas min// zhes rtsa ba'i rgyud la bsnyon dor ba'i tshig ri bong gi cal ltar gyur pa'o// rtsing por na dge ba'i las gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang bskur nas phyis las thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ zhib mor na slob ma dge ba'i las la 'dod pa la der dang mi dge ba'i las bsad sogs lta bu la de'i dbye ba 'chad pa'i dkyil 'khor so sor bskur dgos te/ gang la gang gis gdul ba de la de ston 'os pas so// de'i phyir/ slob dpon dag gi sa gzhi'i gnas su 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dag kyang mtha' dag shes nas ni// bya ba gang gang byed pa de de mtha' dag de ltar 'bras bu dag ni rab tu sbyin par 'gyur// zhes so// 'dis dbang bskur ba'i sngon du las so so'i sa brtag pa 'chad dgos pa sogs kyis gnad shes par 'gyur ro// de'i phyi'i slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i bla mas/ de la so shing sbyin dgos/ de'ang las sam dngos grub gang gi snod du gyur pa shes par bya ba'i ched du'o// 'grel chen las/ dang por slob ma la sogs pa bsrung ba bya ste zhes pas de nas de la bsrung ba bya'o// dus ni/ nag pa'i nya gtso bor byas la/ gzhan de kho na'i nya la dbang bskur gzhan la dgag pa ni ma yin te/ 'grel chen las/ nag pa'i nya gtso bor byas nas nya bcu gnyis po rnams la rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang sbyin par bya zhing*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams rab tu gnas par bya'o 'byung bas so// rnam bcad dang pos sa gzhi gzung*// gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya// nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shes// zhes gsungs pa'ang dbang gi cho ga thams cad la mtha' gcig nges pa ma yin te/

rdzogs pa dag las ni sbyang dang gzung ba dag kyang de bzhin bu rnams dag ni thams cad bsdu// bcu gnyis pa la thig gdab 'dod pa ma nu'i nyin zhag dag la dpal ldan rdul tshon dkye ba nyid// dbang la sogs pa nya la mchog gi bla mas sbyin te bdud ni bcom pa'i nyin zhag dag la yang*// zhes pas/ rdzogs pa gnyis pa la slob ma bsdu ba dang sa'i cho ga byas/ bcu gcig pa la lhag gnas/ bcu gnyis pa la thig bcu gsum bcu bzhi la bri/ nya la dbang bskur ba bshad pa'i phyir ro// sa yi phyogs gang du dang por rdo rje gsum gyi zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin bya ste/ zhes pas bslang ba dang*/ de la sbyang ba ni/ zug rngu sol ba dang bcas rang ni 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed ces pa'i zug rngu de lta bus thun mong dge ba'i las la bla ma dang slob ma la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bas sbyang dgos par bstan/ sa la rin chen dung dang mching bu dag ni rnam rgyal bde byed ces pas dung ngam mching bu'i rigs mthong na bde ba byed pa'i phyir ro// de yang rko ba sogs dgos pa'i sar yin la thams cad du ma yin no// gang du rko dgos pa der lto 'phye brtag dgos pas/ sa gzhi gang yin de gru bzhir byas/ phyogs kyi cha thams cad du re mig dgu bcu byas/ der lto 'phye'i gsang gnas sa'i dbus su bzhag lte ba yan mi gzugs/ sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug pa/ lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du rna ba g.yon pa bzhag nas nyal/ g.yas pa rin chen bzung ste mkhal khung g.yas pa'i steng du bkab/ nyal ba'i lus kyi zheng gi re mig dgu dkyus kyis re mig dgu bcu re non pa/ smad sbrul du yod pa mjug ma'i rtser rigs ldan sngon po/ gsang gnas stobs rgyu ljang khu/ lte bar dung skyong dkar po/ dpung par pad chen ser po/ snying gar nor rgyas ljang khu/ mgrin par 'jog po dmar po/ rna bar padma dkar po/ spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po/

kho rang yang mtha' yas mdog dkar po yin/ de dag lus tshad mtho bcu mtho re la re mig dgu ston zla ra ba'i khyim zhag gi tshes gcig la shar phyogs kyi mtha'i dbang ldan gyi re'u mig dang po la mgo bos sleb pa'i tshe rlung gi mtha'i re mig la mjug rtses sleb/ de nas khyim zhag re la re mig re bgrod pas ston zla gsum la mgo shar/ kha lho/ dgun zla gsum la mgo lho/ kha nub/ dpyid zla gsum la mgo nub/ kha byang*/ dbyar zla gsum la mgo byang*/ kha shar du blta/ de ltar khyim lo gcig las thams cad mgo dang mjug gis 'khor/ des na klu'i rgyal po rnams sa 'og na 'khor tshul de lta bur yod pas/ sa steng du dkyil 'khor dang khang bzang sogs kyi sa brko tshul las yon tan dang nyes par 'gyur la/ des na shar nas gdengs ka zhal mgrin pa gsum la re mig dgu tshan gsum/ mdun gyis non pa'i cha nas phyed dang bcu gsum dor nas shar nub cha dgu lho byang phyed dang lnga tshan gyi mdun te der thog mar brkos na yon tan/ lto 'phye gnas pa'i zheng dkyus kyi re mig gi cha dang rgyab tu brkos na nyes pa cir 'gyur zhe na/ gal te lto 'phye'i rgyal po gnas pa yi// cha dgu'i sa yi cha la brkos na ni// pha ma bu dang bu mo spun chung ma// mna' ma rang gi skye bo mdza' bshes 'chi// gal te rgyab tu brkos na rang 'chi zhing*// yang na rang gnas nas 'pho nor brlag 'gyur// mjug mar glang chen rta dang ma he ra// ba lang 'chi zhing stobs kyang nyams par 'gyur// zhes bi bhū tis bshad do// de ltar brkos ro bsal ba'i phyogs der las mthun gyi sa dang snying po gzhug stegs bu maṇḍal lta bu dbus mtho mtha' byin gyis dma' ba bya/ 'grel chen las/ dkyil 'khor ni rang gi bdag nyi kyi cha yi khru gcig nas brtsams te khru stong ji srid pa de srid du'o zhes pa bzhin bya'o// lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro ni phyis nas rdo rje bzhi yis zhes pas/

sgrub pa'i thabs tshar gcig bsgom pa bstan la/ de nas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs sogs ni bdud 'dul ba'i blos de dpang por 'dzugs pa ste/ byang chub kyi snying por bdud 'dul ba'i dpa' bo dag gi mdzad pa bzhin no// gang dag phyogs rnams kun na sangs rgyas byang chub sogs kyis bla mas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab pa dngos su bshad/ blos bla mar dkyil 'khor ston par gsol ba 'debs pa ni gzhan bzhin du grub pa'i gzhung las kha bskang ste mdzad do// phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas bdud kyi tshogs ni nges par bsreg par bya dang*/ seng ldeng dang ni sra ba'i phur bu zhes sogs kyis gdug pa bsal ba dang gnas bsrung ba gsungs te rdo rje shugs kyi nga rgyal gyis drag sngags dang*/ phur btab bka' sgo stang stabs kyi mthar phur bu khro bo bcur bskyed/ mchod bstod bya ba'i bar ro// 'dir phur pa la rgyu n+ya gro dha sogs brgyad bshad kyang skabs 'dir seng ldeng kho na bzung ba ni 'di drag po yin pa la dgongs so// 'dir phyag rgya dang stangs stabs bshad pa'i dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba'i mthe bong mthe'u chung brkyang pa padma'i 'dab ma ltar bya/ gung mo gnyis mnyam du brkyang ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo phyed 'khyog pa'i tshul du bzhag ming med 'og tu bskum pa lag mthil du son pa/ ral gri'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur bcings te mdzub mo dang gung mo bsgreng ba/ rin po che'i phyag rgya ni sor mo lnga sbyar te gung mo dbus nas steng du phyung ba/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni sor mo rnams 'khor lo'i rtsibs ltar rnam par brgyad gi padma'i phyag rgya ni mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar sor mo lhag ma rnams rkyong ba'o// gtor ma'i skabs su khyi'i phyag rgya zhes pa khu tshur bcas pa mnyam pas mthe'u chung sbrel bzhin pas bskor bas/

gri gug gi phyag rgya ni khu tshur bcas mthe'u chung bsgreng ba'o// stangs stabs ni rkang mgo g.yas kyi g.yon mnan la/ g.yas g.yon bar gsum sgeg pa'o// g.yas brkyang ni rkang pa g.yon bskum ste g.yas pa de las mtho lnga ru brkyang ba/ de go ldog pa g.yon brkyang*/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs pa'i rting pa gnyis kyi bar du sor mo nyer bzhi rkang sor so so'i thad du phyir bgrad pus mo drang por byas pa sa ga de las pus mo ldem byas te bar du khru do yod pa ngang pa'i gshog pa 'dra ba ni zlum po/ rting pa gnyis kyi bar du sor mo nyer drug pus mo ya gcig gyen du cung zad bkan pa rol pa'o// rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad pa gar stabs sam taṇḍa'i stabs so// 'dir dgos pa dang gzhan du dgos pa 'dug stangs/ pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du rkang pa g.yas gan rkyal du gnas pa skyil krung*/ rkang pa g.yas brla g.yon pa'i steng dang g.yon pa yang g.yas pa'i steng du gan rkyal ba rdo rje'i gdan nam skyil krung*/ sa'i ngos la pus mo g.yon gyi steng du pus mo g.yas brkyang zhing rkang pa g.yon gyi steng du rkang pa g.yas pa rkang mthil gyi rgyab tu dpyi bzhag pa lha min gyi gdan nam rus sbal gyi stabs/ rkang pa gnyis mnyam par long bu rkub tshos kyi rtsa ba la reg pa dag ste/ byin pa gnyis dang brla gnyis steng du son pa tsog pu'o// skyil krung phyed pa gnyis te rkang pa g.yon skyil krung bzhin la g.yas tsog pu bzhin la cung zad dud pa dang de ldog pa'o// bshang lam la gnas pa ni rkang pa g.yon pa'i steng du bshang lam bzhag cing g.yas tsog pu bzhin de go ldog pas gnyis te 'dug stangs brgyad/ rkang mthil sprad pa padma'i gdan no// lhag gnas kyi dngos gzhi la rang don gyi lhag gnas dang gzhan don gyi lhag gnas gnyis/ dang po la/ sa lha bum pa thig tshon rdor dril gyi lhag gnas te/ thig skud rdo rje rdul tshon lha dang gshin rje'i chu dag tu ste/

byang du rdo rje dril bu dang*// zhes thig rdul tshon bum pa rdo rje dril bu'i lhag gnas gsungs shing*/ lha'i ni rtsa ba'i tshig de ltar slob dpon dag gis sa gzhi gnas su 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dag kyang mtha' dag shes nas ni/ zhi ba la sogs bya ba gang gang byed pa de de zhes pas lha sta gon bstan te/ sa la lha'i tshogs bkod nas las dang mthun pa'i mchod pa bya bar bshad pa dang*/ sems can rnams la thar pa'i slad du che ge bdag kyang gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhed par bgyid// ces pa de yi mtha'i gsol gdab bshad pas so// bum pa la/ de bzhin shel gyi bum pa dang ni sogs kyis rgyu brgyad/ zlum po brgyad gnyis sor du brjod de sogs kyis tshad bshad pa'i tshad ni/ zhi rgyas la thad ka'i rgyar sor bcu drug mtha' skor na zhe brgyad/ dpangs su nyi shu las/ lte ba la bcu bzhi/ mgrin par sor drug kha la sor brgyad byas pa'i sum cha gcig mtha' dang gnyis bug pa/ mchur sor gnyis 'phyang ba/ grangs bcu'am/ drug gam/ lnga'o// dbye bskrad kyi bum pa'i lte ba sor bcu gnyis/ dpangs su sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ ske sor brgyad/ kha sor drug mchu sor re/ dbang dgug 'jig rten ni ji ltar mdzes pa/ rengs pa la dpangs sor bcu drug mgrin pa sor bzhi/ kha sor drug mchu sor gnyis/ las thams cad ni zhi rgyas dang 'dra bar bshad do// rgyal ba'i bum pa la padma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum/ rnam rgyal la gri gug phyogs shar ral gri nag po/ lhor rin po che dmar po/ nub tu 'khor lo ser po/ byang padma dkar po/ me padma dmar po/ rlung 'khor lo ser po/ dbang ldan utpal dkar po/ yal 'dab dang bcas pa'i shing gis kha brgyan/ phyogs mdog gi gos dang skud pa dkar pos mgul dkris/ yi ge drug pa bzla zhing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/

rin po che lnga/ lcags lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga re mig bzhin btab pa dang chus sum gnyis dgang*/ rnam rgyal chen po/ dung chos/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa dang*/ thig skud bu mo skye gnas ma nyams pas bkal ba dkyil 'khor nyis 'dab/ sbom phra rdo rje slob dpon gyi mthe bo'i nas zhes pa gang bya ba de'i sor tshad bdun du bgos pa'i cha gcig go /kha dog lnga pa/ de yang rdul mun snying stobs dag pas sum bsgril du bya ba'o/ rdul tshon 'grel par de la 'byor pa dang rdzas su mthun pas tshon lnga bya ste/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i 'byor pa la rdo rje la sogs pa rin po che'i phye ma'o zhes/ marka ta/ and+ri nī la/ padma rā ga zla shel/ karka ta mthon kha chen po lnga bshad/ thun mong ba'i 'khor lo sgyur ba rnams kyis gser gyi phye ma ni ser po sogs kyis mu tig byu ru mu man de bzhin bsres pa ljang khu/ dbye ba lnga yi 'bru'am zhes dang*/ btags pa'i tshon thun mong ba dag gis sems can thams cad kyis te zhes pas rgyal po mchog dman bzhin du phal pa'i gnas skabs kyang gnyis te da lta'i rdul tshon 'di ni tha ma'o// rdo rje ni/ nor bu gtsug tor sogs kyis bstan pa rgyan dang gsor ba'o// dang po la rdo rje nor bu dag pas sor gcig gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo sor gnyis/ dpral ba dag pas sor bzhi/ mgrin pa sor lnga/ snying ga sor brgyad/ lte ba sor dgu gsang gnas rnam par dag pas sor bcu gnyis pa'o// de lta bu'i rdo rje rnams zad par rlung sogs nas me rnams kyi bar dag pa'ang yin la/ de las dang po rna rgyan/ mthe bong dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ snying kar 'dogs pa rnams te zhar 'byung ngo*/ tha ma gsor ba'i rdo rje'i tshad/ rdo rje'i rwa gnyis dang lte ba cha mnyam pa'i/ dbus cha gsum du byas pa'i g.yas g.yon pad 'dab brgyad mu khyud zla ba dang bcas pa/ rwa rnams gug pa'i ldir cha sa'i thad nas bskor ba de brkyang na dbus rwa gnyis kyi rtse nas rtser sleb pas chu zheng mnyam pa'i tha snyad byas/

lte ba'i rgya cha sa'i zlum thig la rdo rje srid phyed yod pa/ rwa yang rtse lnga pa phyogs dang rtse dgu pa yin na mtshams nas kyang skyes te phyir song nas slar gug pa zhi ba dbus su rwa'i rtse las cung zad dma' bar reg pa/ khro bo la ma reg pa'o// rtse lnga pa'i rwa rnams ni cha shas bzhi pa/ rwa dbus ma ni drang la gru bzhi pa/ sked rim gsum dang ldan pa/ nas kyi dbyibs can/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams 'og cung zad phra ba/ dbus sbom pa/ rtse 'og ma bas kyang ches phra ba/ sam pu ṭar/ chu srin kha nas byung ba yi// zhes pa ltar chu srin gyi kha bzhi cha de nas phyir phyogs pa tsher ma'i rnam pa lta bu byin gyis phra ba'o// dbus rwa dang gzhan nas tsam ma reg pa'o// dril bu cha gsum mnyam pa sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dang sum cha gnyis zhal nas ba lang kha'i mthar thug pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i zhal 'og ba lang kha zum pa lta ba ni zhi ba/ padma rnam par rgyas pa'i kha ni drag po'o// rgyan la sogs pa rgyud gzhan nas so// steng du rdo rje ji lta ba'o/ rdo rje'i lte ba la sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi thig le dag pa'i zhal bzhi yod pa dang*/ dril bu la rnam par thar pa sgo bzhi dag pa'i zhal bzhi yod pa dang*/ yang 'grel chen las/ nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can// zhes kā li gsal byed kyi chos brjod du med pa ste dbyangs med pa'i phyir ro// des na rdo rje'i lte ba la zhal med do// mtshan mo shes rab rab tu grags// zhes pa ni/ ā li dbyangs kyi chos te/ des brjod pa'i rang bzhin gyi phyir bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal gcig go zhes pa ni dril bu la grub bo// zhes rigs gnyis gsungs pa'i deng sang phyi ma'i rjes 'brang ngo*// gnyis pa gzhan don gyi lhag gnas la/ de nas slob ma lhag par gnas par bya ste sogs kyis dngos su so shing byin rlabs bsrung ba tsam las ma bshad kyang lhag ma grub pa'i lung gis kha bskang ste rgyud ni bla ma'i man ngag gis dgrol bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas khrus/

maṇḍal/ gsol gdab sdom pa/ brtul zhugs/ dam tshig sgrag pa/ so shing*/ khyor chu/ bsrung skud/ go cha dang*/ byin rlabs/ ku sha chos bshad rnams dang*/ mtshan ma brtag pa'i phyir mal stan gyi lhag gnas/ gtor ma sreg rab tu gnas pa'i lhag gnas so// lhag gnas kyi rjes ni bum pa dang tshom bu bsdu ba dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa'i cho ga rnams so// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa la yang yan lag sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang brgyan pa'o/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ thig gdab tshon 'gyed pa ste/ thig byin rlabs mchod nas las so so'i dbang gis shrī khaṇḍa nas ba bla'i chu'i bar du gsungs pa'i cha la gang rung gis spangs nas/ bla ma'i g.yon pa skyil krung phyed pa dang g.yas pa'i mthil sar bzhag pa don mnyam pa'i rkang stabs/ slob ma de las go ldog pa mi mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyis shar nub kyi tshangs thig gdab bo// de nas lho byang*/ mtshams la sogs pa'o// 'di la 'grel chen las/ me dang rlung gi ji snyed gnas pa'i sde gnyis po dag gi dbus su gdengs can bzhin du dbyug pa'i rnam pa ste yongs 'joms 'gongs pa las g.yul du sde ni nyams par 'gyur te sa gzhi dag tu mtshan ma'i 'thab mo la ni bsnun par 'gyur zhing*/ dkyil 'khor la 'thab mo dang rtsod par 'gyur ro// de phyir g.yul dang dbang dag la yang yongs 'joms shin tu stobs dang ldan par sngags pas rig par bya zhes pa 'di ni gzhan dkyil 'khor la 'di/ phyi 'jig rten la sgra gcan te/ gdong mer dang mjug ma rlung du gnas pa yin no// mtshams de las 'da' ba ni 'gongs pa zhes bya'o// slob ma byang shar du gnas dgos pas mer dang*/ slob dpon nub byang ste rlung du sgra gcan gyi gdong mjug dang*/ thug pa'i nyes pa lta bur 'gyur ba yin no// 'on kyang thig skud chad na slob dpon la ngan pa bzhin yongs 'joms 'gongs pa'ang slob ma rnams la ste/

de dag 'thab pa dang rtsod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin rdul tshon byin rlabs 'gyed pa'i dus su de rlung gis 'khyer na yul 'khor dang*/ bla ma dang*/ rgyal po 'jig par 'gyur ro// de bas na mtshan ma ngan pa de bzlog pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis gtso bo'i bsnyen pa bya ste/ slar mtshan ma bzang por 'gyur ba na dbang bskur ba gsungs so// rdul tshon gyi dpangs kyang 'grel chen las/ shar du reg bya'i yon tan rnam par dag pas rdul tshon nag po ni nas kyi rkang pa gcig gi dpangs so// zhes sogs kyis lhor dmar po rkang pa gnyis/ byang du dkar po rkang pa gsum/ nub tu ser po rkang pa bzhi/ thugs las gsung nyis 'gyur/ de las sku nyis 'gyur/ gzhan bcad kyi re khā thun mong ba dag ni rdul tshon ser po'i nyis 'gyur/ padma mi zla nyi nyis 'gyur do shal phyed pa nas gcig dbye ba gzhan ni thams cad du yon tan gsum gyi dbye bas sa thams cad la tshad mtshungs pa ste/ rwa ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi tshad las sum 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ 'dir nas kyang rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi drug cu rtsa brgyad lhag pa'i bdun brgya'i cha shas su rig par bya'o// de la re khā sbom pas sbyin bdag gam slob dpon la nad byed/ phra ba'am ngan pas rdzas nyams/ chad pas 'chi ba/ 'khyog pos mi'i bdag po dang bcas pa'i grong brdal bskyod pa/ gdan chad na dngos grub med/ phan tshun rdul tshon 'dres na sbyin bdag dang slob dpon gyi rigs brgyud 'chad/ mtshan ma 'grel chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pas mtshan ma gsal bar ma gsungs pa'i mtshan ma de ni mdzes pa'i don du dkyil 'khor la dgod par mi bya'o// ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtshan ma de ni bdud kyi mtshan mar 'gyur te phyin ci log pa dang lhag pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas so// mtshan ma'ang*/ 'dir thams cad du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nyi dang zla ba'i gdan rnams la rags pa dang*/

phra mo dang*/ gzhan pa'i dbye ba dgod pa rnam pa gsum ste/ de la gzhan gyi dbye ba ni sngags kyi sa bon dgod pa'o// phra mo'i dbye ba ni sngags kyi sa bon yongs su gyur pa/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dgod pa'o// rags pa'i dbye ba ni rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa'i lha'i gzugs dgod pa'o// zhes dang*/ 'dir gtso ba'i sngags kyi sa bon dgod pa gsungs so// zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la 'jig rten pa'i smod pa yongs su spang ba'i slad du lha'i gzugs ni bri bar mi bya'o// zhes so// sa bon mtshan mar byas na sang lha bskyed pa'ang sa bon las lhar slong*/ phyag mtshan bris nas sa bon de las phyag mtshan de las lhar slong dgos par bshad do// des na lha dgod pa ni blos bslang ras bris kyi tshe yin la/ 'dir sa bon nam phyag mtshan 'god par bya zhing*/ ri mo rgyud nas ma bshad pa lag bde'i stabs su ma btang ngo*// dkyil 'khor mchod pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag sgrub dang*/ gzhan sgrub gnyis/ dang po la bdag mdun bum gsum dang po ni/ 'grel chen las 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs byas nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog dang thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor bya ste zhes pas so// gnyis pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dam tshig dkyil 'khor du bsgoms nas de la ro mnyam du byas te/ dbang gi don du'o zhes sogs so// bum bskyed du lha'i tshogs kyi snying po'i mtshan ma rang rang gi rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho gas bkod par gyur pa na/ zur du shel gyi bum pa dkar po skud pa lnga yis dkris pa yang dag par bzhag pa sogs dang*/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa'i mdun du gzhan khru gang ba'i dkyil 'khor byas te sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa'i mchod yon 'bul ba nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar du byas/

bum bzlas/ phyi rol tu gtor ma btang nang du log ste shar sgo dbye ba dang rkang pa brgyad pa zlos shing bskor ba dang*/ me tog 'phreng ba phul slar blangs mgo bor bcings te gsol ba gdab/ ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang len no// gnyis pa gzhan bsgrub pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la cho ga'i chings ni/ khrus dang*/ gsol btab/ brtul zhugs lnga sbyin pa dang*/ smad g.yogs/ stod g.yogs/ thod dang*/ mig dar/ so shing*/ khyor chu/ sgo gsum sbyang ba/ dri ba dri lan/ 'jug yon/ maṇḍal/ rnal 'byor sems bskyed/ gsang bar gdams pa/ dkyil 'khor du dgug pa/ gzhug pa/ skor ba dang phyag phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i dam bzhag bzhi/ byin dbab/ gshegs su gsol ba/ bsrung ba/ me tog dor ba/ brda sprod pa/ me tog slar sbyin pa/ mig 'byed/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa rnams so// gsang bar gdams pa phan yol ba phyi 'jug lhag ma nang 'jug dam bzhag ni byin dbab kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ byin dbab rang ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ngo ma yin no// khro bo dbab rgyu'i gtso bo ni rdo rje'i shugs so// gzhan ni khro bo bcu so so yang 'bab pa yin la/ gang babs so so'i phyag rgya bcings pas shes so// de dag phebs na dge mi dge la sogs pa'i don dris te slar gshegs gsol bya yi/ gzhan rdo rje bzhi phebs pa dang de bzhin dus sogs 'byung ba lnga dang lha'i mig la sogs pa lnga 'bab pa la ni gshegs gsol mi dgos te bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bshad pa'o// de yang*/ rang stobs sam gzhan stobs kyis yin pa zhe na/ 'grel chen las/ 'dir lha 'bab pa gang yin pa de ni nges par zhes pa mtha' cig tu gyur te/ sngags pa slob dpon rnams kyis sgom pa'i stobs dang sngon du bsnyen pa'i dbye ba ni zhes pa cho ga sna tshogs pa dang rnam mang dam tshig byang chub sems dpa' thig le la sogs pa bsrung ba dang*/

de bzhin du sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pa dag gis kyang phebs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni mi 'gyur ro// 'ga' zhig dag gi tshe bla ma brgyud pa rnam par dag pa'i slob ma la ste/ sangs rgyas ro myang byed pas bdud rtsi'i dbang las dkyil 'khor 'gar ni mchog gi bu la 'gyur ro// zhes pas/ lha phebs pa ni sngags kyi gdul bya dang de'i slob dpon lhag ma ni bsam gtan pa dang de'i slob dpon gyi gtso bor 'gyur bas rang stobs gzhan stobs gnyis ka'o// sngon bal por paṇa chen bi bhū tis byin dbab mdzad pa na byin babs pa'i slob ma gcig nam mkha' la gar bsgyur gyin song ste ma log pas/ paṇḍi ta phyis byin 'bebs mi mdzad ces grags so// me tog dor sa/ 'grel par/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyir rol tu rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du sngar brjod pa'i rim pas me tog dor ba dang*/ zhes gsungs/ 'di'i dgos pa zhig khru stong lta bu la me tog lha la mi 'phog pas lha la 'phog par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnyis par rdul tshon bsub par 'gyur pa dogs pa ste/ de bsubs na de nyid du/ rab tu gnas par byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon bsubs pa las mchod rten 'jig pa'o// zhes nyes pa de yod pas so// dkyil 'khor gyi lha bstan pa yang rim pa gnyis te/ rdul tshon gyi rten brten par bcas pa ston pa mtshon byed dpe yin la/ mngon sum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mthong na snga ma la bltos pa'i mtshon bya don du 'gyur ba/ mar pas mi la la bstan pa bzhin no// dang po de tsam gyis kyang*/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*/ de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// zhes 'byung bas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du gdul bya chos mi ldan la dbang mi bskur kyang 'jug pas bsdu bar bshad pa ni dgos pa de gzigs pas so// de bas na dbang thob pa la dkyil 'khor mthong ba nges par dgos byung la/

dbang ma thob pa la dkyil 'khor ston mi rung ba yin no// zhugs pa tsam gyis gdul bya la dgongs nas sngar lha'i gzugs dkyil 'khor du mi dgod par gsungs pa ste/ de dag kha sbyor gyi sku la ma mos par gyur dogs pa'o// dbang bskur ma thob pa la gsang rgyu bstan na gsang sgrog 'byung*/ thob nas mi 'byung rgyu ba zhig phal cher 'dod mod/ de yang rigs pa ma yin te/ dam la bzhag pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la gsang bar gdams kyis zhugs pa la ma yin pa dang*/ 'og mar zhugs kyang gong mar ma dad pas 'jug mi 'os pa yod pas/ ma dad pa la'ang zhes 'byung ba dang*/ dbang bdun tsam thob kyang bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs par ston mi thub pa dang*/ de'i khar dbang gsum byin na thub pa dang*/ de la'ang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa gsang ba bsgrags par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyud 'byongs na mchog dbang bskur te/ de nas rdzogs rim ston dgos pas so// rgyud sde gzhan la snod dang*/ cho ga dang cho ga rdzogs pas dang*/ zab mos 'jigs pa dang*/ nyams pas ma smin pa zhes lngar bshad pa bzhin la/ nyams pa ni phyir ma gsos ring sngags pa'i tha snyad med/ rnam gzhag 'di mthong na rdo rje slob dpon dang mched por bsgral bar khas len pa'i sngags pa nag po rnams la a rdzi rdzi'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la/ dbang bdun bskur ba dang*/ gong chung gsum bskur ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ chu ni sgrol ma la sogs lha mo cod pan zhes pa rgyal ba dpa' bo dar dpyangs nus ma rnams// rdo rje dril bu nyi zla dag dang brtul zhugs dag kyang yul de ming ni byams sogs sbyor ba'o// rjes gnang rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal mo srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo rjes su rig pa ste// zhes pa ni dbang bdun po yin la/ de yang*/ dpe byis pa skyes ma thag ma yis 'khrud pa dang chos mthun/ sbyang gzhi khams lnga'i dri ma 'khrud/
